_doc: Weapon landmarks per aligned 340x340 keyframe (kaelen_4pose_uris.json), read off a 20 px grid. butt = shaft end, socket = metal collar under the blade, tip = blade's far point, grip_front / grip_back = the hands on the shaft. The hybrid in-betweener rebuilds the halberd from the canonical keyframe as one rigid prop placed by these points.
